- Every normative claim in the 11 hub/baseline/factor documents of this tree traces to a rule sentence, ladder tier, tool docstring, base clause or tier figure. Elaborations checked and found entailed: interest "payment date" = date paid (compute `NOW`); due proof = the death claim with certificate received (compute filter `death_certificate_received=True`); approval = its decision date; "before" = report received earlier than proof; twelve-month test = issued installments' federal withholding total > 0; "rate chosen, including 0 %" = election carries a rate (compute `elected_rate != None`); "whole payment period" for the pending count (compute `int`); cost-of-living segments and the >= 36-month discount mechanics (compute `seg1..3`, `growth_v`).

- Omissions: D1 below.

### Difference list
- **D1 (omission, untriggered branch).** Source `income_ext_commuted_value_payout`, factor `commuted_value_investment_in_contract`, ladder tier 3 "when: otherwise — method: the investment in the contract is the purchase amount" (also in the rule: "…; and otherwise the purchase amount"). Not entailed by the KB: `commuted_value_investment_in_contract_4e2b0043` — "An Income Annuities contract in neither situation is outside this rule." and table "New money | Non-qualified | Outside this rule"; `commuted_value_net_payment_cdf15cdc` carries no investment notion; `commuted_value_taxable_part_bab42ae9` needs one ("It is the investment in the contract less the tax-free amount already recovered"). Symptom: for a non-qualified commuted value on a contract not bought by annuitizing an Ashgrove deferred annuity (new money, 1035 exchange), the visible taxable-part rule cannot be evaluated (or is read as "outside" and the baseline exclusion-ratio split is applied), whereas the source taxes the commuted value less (purchase amount − tax-free amount already recovered), never below zero. Root cause: the factor's default value lives only in `factors[].baseline` and the ladder's otherwise tier; the computation document had no place for it and the factor document renders the otherwise tier as "outside this rule". Task 0's numbers are unaffected (annuitized contract, tier 1). Affected: `commuted_value_investment_in_contract_4e2b0043` (opening paragraph closing sentence, table last row) with `commuted_value_net_payment_cdf15cdc` (no investment input).

## bijection_verdict
**KB-BIJECTION RED** — D1 (`commuted_value_investment_in_contract_4e2b0043` / `commuted_value_net_payment_cdf15cdc`): the purchase-amount tier of the commuted-value investment factor is not carried, so the full domain of `income_ext_commuted_value_payout` is not losslessly rendered. All other atoms of the three policies, both prerequisites, the retired surfaces and the base clauses correspond. First revision; no earlier revision exists.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- PS1: the `baseline.rule` texts of the arrears, reissue and release policies state the tax-free part without a cap, while their factor defaults (`investment = F('purchase_amount')`) and compute apply the cap; the KB computation docs follow the compute (cap at the purchase amount). Benign here; recorded for the policy layer.
- PS2: `commuted_value_investment_in_contract` tier 2 (IRA -> zero) can never bear weight on a commuted value, because the taxable-part factor that consumes the investment applies only to non-qualified contracts.
- PS3: the "added undiscounted" part of `commuted_installment_count` (beneficiary continuing) is always zero whenever the commutation prerequisite holds (every span installment must already stand issued), so that sub-tier never bears weight at an election made after the prerequisite is met.
